Device Name: Orbit Galaxy® G2 Microcoil Delivery System
Indications for Use:
The Fill Orbit Galaxy® G2 Microdelivery System is intended for endovascular embolization of
intracranial aneurysms, other neurovascular abnormalities such as arteriovenous malformations
and arteriovenous fistulae, and is intended for arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral
vasculature.
The Xtrasoft Orbit Galaxy® 02 Microcoil Delivery System is intended for endovascular
embolization of intracranial aneurysms.
